query: SELECT DISTINCT e.event_type AS "event_type!", f.field AS "field!" FROM account_holder_events e JOIN (SELECT UNNEST($2::text[]) AS event_type, UNNEST($3::text[]) AS field) f ON e.event_type = f.event_type WHERE e.id = $1 AND e.event -> f.field IS NOT NULL AND e.event -> f.field != 'null'::jsonb
